run_metadata.coverage_summary: Swept all nine Tier-1 government portals (AusTender, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/Queensland Supplier Portal + VendorPanel Marketplace, Tenders WA, SA Tenders and Contracts, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) via live web search, prioritising notices published or updated in the last 7 days. Tier-2 sampled across GBEs/water utilities (Sydney Water, Australia Post, NBN Co) and local councils on VendorPanel/TenderLink. Tier-3 corporate channel checked (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery, Australia Post e-sourcing) as mandated. Captured 5 genuinely new opportunities distinct from the ~185 previously-seen tenders, with full deliverables/detail on the two Commonwealth RFTs and headline-level capture (pending detail) on the three where the detail page was login-gated or returned 403. Found 2 new local-government sources (Balonne Shire Council QLD, Lachlan Shire Council NSW).
gaps: AusTender ATM detail pages (tenders.gov.au/Atm/Show/...) consistently returned HTTP 403 to the automated fetcher; details for AFMA 2025/2026-02 and ATM_2026_6984 were reconstructed from AusTender search-result summaries, not the full notice pages. Several other current Commonwealth ATMs observed in listings (e.g. RFT-2026-0080, PROCFY26051, OET-DRC-2026, AACAP 2026-P04, AFMA25-26-3) could not be opened to confirm buyer/scope/dates and were NOT recorded as tenders to avoid fabrication.
auspost.com.au tendering & supply opportunities page returned HTTP 403; Australia Post current-opportunity list could not be read this run.

SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery: no publicly-visible Australian RFx surfaced via search; full opportunity detail requires a free supplier login. Recorded as a registration-gated portal in prior runs; no individual corporate opportunity captured this run (none publicly visible without authentication).
buy.nsw opportunity detail for the Sydney Harbour Bridge blasting & vacuuming equipment tender could not be deep-linked from search; captured at headline level with buyer unconfirmed.
Buying for Victoria: no clearly new (last-7-day) open tender confirmed at detail level this run; portal reachable but specific fresh notices not verifiable without an authenticated browse.
Tier-3 invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope (never publicly published) — not fabricated.
recommended_seed_additions: Balonne Shire Council (QLD) — publishes via VendorPanel Marketplace / QTenders; observed a live kerb & footpath works tender.
Lachlan Shire Council (NSW) — runs its own TenderLink e-Tendering portal (portal.tenderlink.com / tenderlink.com/lachlan); not previously in the known-source list.

tenders.title: Charter Vessel Services Panel — combatting illegal foreign fishing
tenders.category: Charter vessel services / maritime fisheries patrol services
tenders.description: AFMA is establishing a panel of service providers to supply charter vessel services to combat and deter illegal foreign fishing around Australia, its external territories, and on the high seas where Australia has an interest. Providers may tender for one or more services in one or more locations.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Supply of chartered vessels and associated crew/services for ad hoc engagements (typically 3 days to 3 months) covering fisheries patrols, land-based disposal support, disposal at sea, and foreign-fishing marine-debris retrieval and land disposal, in support of Australia's maritime fisheries enforcement.
key_deliverables: Foreign-fishing marine-debris retrieval and land disposal
tenders.scope_of_work: Panel of vessel service providers for ad hoc engagements combatting/deterring illegal foreign fishing across Australian waters, external territories and relevant high-seas areas. Engagements typically between 3 days and 3 months depending on the service and area of operation.
tenders.eligibility: Open to all; providers may submit a response for one or more services within one or more locations.
tenders.contract_term: Initial term 3 years with the option for a single 3-year extension
tenders.delivery_location: Australian waters, external territories, and high-seas areas of Australian interest
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM search-result summary for AFMA 2025/2026-02 (full ATM detail page returned HTTP 403)
tenders.reasoning: Surfaced via AusTender current-ATM web search; buyer-originated Commonwealth notice on tenders.gov.au.
tenders.notes: Questions-due date (07-Aug-2026) confirmed from summary; overall closing date and estimated value not captured because the full ATM page returned 403. Contract term (3+3 years) and scope reconstructed from the AusTender summary text.

tenders.title: National Ecosystem Accounts (NEA) Technical Expert Reference Group (TERG) — member appointments
tenders.buyer: Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW)
tenders.description: DCCEEW is seeking to appoint up to 10 members to a new National Ecosystem Accounts (NEA) Technical Expert Reference Group (TERG) for 12 months (with possible extension to 24 months). TERG will provide independent, expert technical advice to support development and continuous improvement of the National Ecosystem Accounts.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Provision of independent expert technical advice, as members of a reference group, to support the development and continuous improvement of Australia's National Ecosystem Accounts (natural-capital / ecosystem accounting under the DCCEEW work program).
key_deliverables: Independent expert technical advice to DCCEEW on National Ecosystem Accounts
Participation as a TERG member over the appointment term
Input into continuous improvement of NEA methods
tenders.scope_of_work: Appointment of up to 10 individuals with relevant technical expertise to the National Ecosystem Accounts Technical Expert Reference Group, providing independent advice supporting NEA development and improvement.
tenders.eligibility: Open to suitably qualified individuals/experts (up to 10 members to be appointed).
tenders.contract_term: 12 months, with possible extension to 24 months
tenders.detail_source: AusTender ATM search-result summary for ATM_2026_6984 (full ATM detail page returned HTTP 403)
tenders.reasoning: Surfaced via AusTender current-ATM web search filtered to recently-published notices; buyer-originated Commonwealth notice published 03-Aug-2026.
tenders.notes: Publish date (03-Aug-2026), closing (28-Aug-2026 2:00pm ACT), buyer (DCCEEW), category (Ecological advisory services) and member count/term confirmed from AusTender summary. Estimated value and contact details not captured (full ATM page returned 403).

tenders.eligibility: Open to suitably qualified and experienced organisations (EOI stage).

tenders.reasoning: Discovered via buy.nsw opportunity search for Sydney Water; buyer-originated GBE EOI published on the NSW eTendering / buy.nsw platform.
tenders.notes: Headline-level capture pending detail. Closing date, value, contact and full scope not yet extracted from the opportunity detail page. Tender reference SWC-WS4645974632 / WS4645974632 as shown in the buy.nsw listing.

tenders.deliverables_summary: Supply, install and ongoing service of blasting and vacuuming equipment to support maintenance / abrasive-blasting operations at the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
